stories.title: Goldman Sachs names 22 Indian high‑growth stocks, initiates buy ratings on 21
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs identified 22 Indian companies it views as exposed to structural growth themes and started Buy ratings on 21 of them. The list features Bharti Airtel, Eternal and several banks—including HDFC Bank (27% EPS growth), ICICI Bank (15%), Axis Bank (19%), AU Small Finance Bank (27%) and Federal Bank (18%) projected for FY 2027‑28. Indian equities have rallied in recent weeks despite broader global market weakness.
stories.why: The new Buy ratings may steer institutional and retail investors toward firms seen as high‑growth opportunities.

stories.title: Five BSE 200 stocks hit 52‑week highs as Sensex climbs
stories.summary: The benchmark Sensex rose 990 points to close at 83,021, and five BSE 200 stocks reached fresh 52‑week highs. Their closing prices ranged from Rs 191.85 to Rs 2,194.05, with monthly gains of about 15% to 28% and one stock up roughly 27% in the past month. The rally suggests heightened market activity.
stories.why: It indicates strong investor interest and momentum that could affect short‑term trading strategies.

stories.title: Ukrainian troops fight Russian forces inside a narrow Soviet gas pipeline in Kharkiv region
stories.summary: Ukrainian soldiers have been stationed for roughly seven months inside an abandoned Soviet‑era gas pipeline in the Kharkiv region, where they are engaged in close‑quarter combat with Russian troops. The pipeline’s interior is just over a metre in diameter, forcing combatants to crawl. Its underground location shields the fighters from the heavy drone presence that dominates the skies above the front line, limiting aerial surveillance and movement for both sides.
stories.why: The subterranean setting reduces drone effectiveness and changes the tactical balance on the front.

stories.title: India on track to hit $1 trillion export target by FY 2026‑27, says commerce secretary
stories.summary: India's exports grew 16.6% in the first half of the current fiscal year. The previous fiscal year recorded a total of $863 billion in exports, a historic high. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said the country remains on schedule to reach the $1 trillion export goal for FY 2026‑27 despite global trade uncertainties.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
